evaluationExposure.observation: More nonliteral comparisons were sent to the judge; original27 judge requests rose from 224 to 285. Repeated identical comparisons can therefore expose a correct unchanged memory to another stochastic verdict. New source-form wording and self-contained sentences rarely match the abbreviated gold literally. This is observed exposure, not an isolated causal ablation of each prompt edit.
